metadata.name: Blinded official-source VoiceOps holdout
metadata.provenance: Authored from official kb/*.md, DATA_DICTIONARY.md, ZIP_SCHEMA.md and selected data/{products,pincodes,orders,order_items,customers}.csv only. No practice prompts, adversarial cases, agent answer code, credentials, or runtime outputs were read during authoring.
metadata.freeze_policy: Questions and rubrics were frozen before any Agent.respond invocation. Do not tune or remove cases based on outcomes. Preserve failures.
judging_limitations: Deterministic regex assertions approximate semantics and can miss paraphrases or subtle contradictions; failures should be reviewed against stored answers.
Source membership checks show retrieved evidence coverage, not proof that every generated claim is entailed.
Tool checks validate exposed mock-call records, not production authentication or real-world action completion.
Hindi and Hinglish cases are independently authored and have not received native-speaker, human-rater, or organizer validation.
This is an independent holdout, not an organizer benchmark or an unbiased estimate of all possible customer conversations.

single_cases.question: For the grey Nimbus X2 Lite earbuds ELE-0005, distinguish the manufacturer's cover from ZentroMart's own cover. Does one replace the other?
